target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test one current reduction-based techno construction, one adjacent psychedelic breakbeat-techno title track, and three overlooked staggered, lopsided or drumless catalogue forms. Character change is allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT 2026 / ALEX MEIN SMITH: https://alexmeinsmith.bandcamp.com/album/hem and https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-electronic/the-best-electronic-music-on-bandcamp-july-2026 — all four tracks on Hem were screened. Neon Data Void was retained as the strongest current lead from an album officially framed as loop-free, focused yet loose, subtle and dissolving; that framing is release-level, not an invented exact-track observation.

ADJACENT / EMERGING WAREHOUSE MUSIC: https://ra.co/reviews/34158 — all four tracks on Cici's debut Extraneous EP were screened. The exact title track was retained from Resident Advisor's description of a straight kick giving way quickly to lopsided motion and a breakbeat.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / XL: https://ra.co/reviews/22435 — all four Piper remixes were screened. Jonny L — Piper (Peverelist Remix) was retained from the exact lopsided-techno and sideways-stagger description; the version is explicit and must not be substituted.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / ONGAKU-SISTER MIDNIGHT: https://ra.co/reviews/34930 — the original four Tracks On Delivery patterns and later reissue context were screened. Roman Flügel — Pattern One was retained from the exact lopsided-bounce and percussive-touch description.

OVERLOOKED / ADJACENT ACTING PRESS: https://ra.co/reviews/35646 — all four Anonymousmaterial tracks were screened. PLO Man — fig. 015 was retained from the exact drumless, warped dub-techno loop and lopsided repeated-motif description.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Posthuman's July 2026 Gang of 404, ReKab's 2026 Subtle Beginnings reissue, current September 4 Bandcamp essentials, Mono Junk's IÄTI and Cici/PLO Man label-adjacent catalogues were screened. Their weaker track-specific evidence did not outrank the five leads.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 41 named tracks across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–68 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

The exact Piper remix version is a deliberate lead and may not be replaced by the original or another remixer. No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, perceived pulse, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown. Release-level language for Neon Data Void is kept explicitly weaker than exact-track evidence.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Cici — Extraneous: strongest exact internal-turn case, moving rapidly from straight kick into a lopsided breakbeat construction.
2. Jonny L — Piper (Peverelist Remix): strongest exact staggered-techno catalogue case, with an explicit version identity.
3. PLO Man — fig. 015: strongest drumless different-world case, a repeated dub-techno motif described as becoming lopsided.
4. Roman Flügel — Pattern One: overlooked minimal-techno pattern with exact lopsided-bounce and percussion evidence.
5. Alex Mein Smith — Neon Data Void: current reduction-based lead whose evidence is album-level rather than track-specific.
